operations.name: list_repositories
operations.title: List repositories
operations.description: List the GitHub repositories you may read. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_repository
operations.title: Get a repository
operations.description: Read a repository's details, such as its default branch and description.

operations.name: list_issues
operations.title: List issues
operations.description: List issues in a repository, most recently updated first, without pull requests. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_issue
operations.title: Read an issue
operations.description: Read an issue or pull request conversation: its text and its first 30 comments.

operations.name: list_pull_requests
operations.title: List pull requests
operations.description: List pull requests in a repository, most recently updated first. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_pull_request
operations.title: Read a pull request
operations.description: Read a pull request with its first 100 changed files and their diffs (at most 50000 characters of diff in total). Use get_issue for its comments.

operations.name: read_file
operations.title: Read a file
operations.description: Read a text file from a repository, or list a directory. Files up to 1 MB can be read.

operations.name: create_issue
operations.title: Open an issue
operations.description: Open an issue with a title and text in a repository where you have create permission. Everyone who can see the repository sees what you write; mentions notify people, subscribers are notified, and the repository's automation may run.

operations.name: add_comment
operations.title: Comment
operations.description: Comment on an issue or pull request in a repository where you have create permission. Everyone who can see the repository sees what you write; mentions notify people, subscribers are notified, and the repository's automation may run.

actions.label: Read code, issues and pull requests
